about: Exercise questions about the photosynthesis page (eval/photosynthesis_card.json) with their correct answers, for Homework mode. An answer is correct if it contains any of the 'any_of' words or numbers as whole words. Written by the recipe author; review before relying on them.

items.question: A leaf makes 12 grams of glucose a day. It uses one third for energy and stores the rest as starch. How many grams of starch does it store in 5 days?
A plant makes 18 grams of glucose a day and stores two thirds of it as starch. How many grams of starch does it store in 7 days?
A leaf makes 10 grams of glucose each day and uses half of it for energy. How many grams of starch has it stored after 4 days?
A leaf makes 9 grams of glucose a day and stores the rest as starch after using one third for energy. After how many days will it have stored 30 grams of starch?
A plant gets sunlight and water but no carbon dioxide at all. Can it make food? Answer yes or no, then explain.
Which gas does a plant release into the air when it makes its food?
A plant is kept in a dark cupboard and watered every day. Which of the three things it needs to make food is missing?
Through which tiny pores does carbon dioxide get into a leaf?
A gardener says that adding more soil gives a plant more food. Is the gardener right? Answer yes or no, then explain.
In which part of the plant does photosynthesis mainly happen?
